generated_query:
SELECT ?year (COUNT(?member) AS ?count) WHERE {
  ?member p:P39 ?statement .
  ?statement ps:P39 wd:Q16707842 ;
             pq:P580 ?start .
  BIND(YEAR(?start) AS ?year)
  FILTER(?year >= 1830 && ?year <= 1910)
  ?statement pq:P1365 ?previousSeat .
  FILTER(?previousSeat != wd:Q1936384)
}
GROUP BY ?year
ORDER BY ?year
